description: Lauren repeatedly countered Tracey Mann's claims, pointing out that he has consistently voted against the interests of Kansans in favor of the Trump agenda. Lauren expressed her concerns about impending hits to rural hospitals and reiterated her dedication to reversing the trajectory of increasing daily costs (groceries, everyday good, gas/diesel, healthcare) rapidly out-pacing income.https://hayspost.com/posts/d890f82e-cc68-437b-8b51-60d5f7eddd6e
